newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah stable on election day.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah stable on election day.

text.p: The indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar on Thursday morning in thin trading as Indonesians began voting in the general election, dealers said.
They said activity was mainly generated from Singapore while the Jakarta centre was only half-filled due to the polls.
One Japanese bank dealer said the rupiah was firm at the opening on buying from Singapore, with local dollar purchases supporting its downside at the 2,439-rupiah level.
"If there is no major trouble at the elections today, the rupiah is likely to strengthen," the Japanese bank dealer said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,440.00/41.00 at 0220 gmt compared with an opening of 2,439.00/40.00.
Dealers said liquidity was ample, with overnight money traded at 8.0 percent. The central bank offers overnight bilateral papers (SPI) at 5.0 percent.
One local bank dealer said rates were trapped in a narrow range between 2,439.0 and 2,441 in the morning and were likely to remain so for the rest of the day.
There will be no clearing by the central bank on Thursday due to the general elections. Dealers said volume was expected to reduce to a minimum due to the polls.
"There is no clear trend in the market yet. Sentiment is a bit mixed," the local bank dealer said.
He said offshore players were seen selling dollars at the opening but seemed to buy it back later.
The dealers also said a fire at a building used Bank Negara Indonesia in Jakarta's Kota district early on Thursday added to caution in the market but had no impact on the rupiah.
Police said the fire apparently started as a result of a short circuit.
